interface.title: wissi-viz (v0.13.0): whole-slide histology viewer with annotation and spatial analysis
interface.field: Digital pathology / spatial biology (H&E whole-slide imaging, cell-level spatial statistics)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of images after acquisition: viewing slides, annotating cells, quantifying spatial patterns, measuring regions
interface.what_it_is_for: Pan and zoom across whole-slide H&E images, overlay and inspect cell or object layers, mark example cells with SAM or drawing tools, and run spatial statistics (density and hotspots, nearest neighbours, Ripley's L, neighbourhood enrichment, Moran's I, region composition). Each statistic gives a table, a slide overlay and a chart.

data.note: Server-bundled sample_data: synthetic_he.svs (synthetic Aperio H&E, 0.5 µm/px) with its same-stem synthetic_he.geojson. The GeoJSON loaded on its own after about 10 s as a 120,725-object layer: Immune 69,805, Stroma 48,686, Tumor 2,232 and 2 ROI objects (tumour ROI polygon and margin line). The tool treats these 2 ROI objects as a fourth 'class' alongside the three cell types, so they appear in the Summary, the Neighbour enrichment matrix and Composition. synthetic_he_cells.tsv and synthetic_he_rois.geojson never showed up in the slide list or as layers. Adding a layer seems to need a native file picker, and there were no test files to give it. The browser tab crashed twice, both times while a whole-layer 'Find all like these' was measuring the 120k objects. After the first crash I reloaded, which reset all client-side layers and results. The screenshot counter also restarted, so screens/001–009 now show the post-reload session (SAM, drawing, Image tab), not the first survey. screens/010–066 are from the first session.

features.name: Layer styling panel with per-class toggles and colour-by-measurement
features.general: Show a set of detected objects over an image. Set opacity, outline and fill. Hide or recolour individual categories, or switch to colouring every object by a numeric measurement with a legend.
features.specific: In the Layers tab, expand synthetic_he.geojson and adjust Opacity/Outline/Fill. Tick or untick Immune/Stroma/Tumor/ROI (counts and bars shown), edit class colours, and set Colour by = class or area (viridis, legend 68.1–264).

features.name: Analysis result card: headline numbers, chart, overlay, table, CSV
features.general: Each analysis run gives a card with key statistics and a chart. The card also adds coloured layers to the image and offers the per-item table and a CSV download, so you can read the result as numbers, as a chart and in space.
features.specific: In the Analyze tab, pick a method, set its parameters (Cells, Grid, From/To, Within, Measurement, Run on this image/project) and press Run. The Results card shows e.g. MEDIAN/PEAK/HOTSPOTS with a histogram, a Ripley curve or an enrichment heatmap. It adds layers (Density, Hotspots, Nearest lines) with legends on the slide, plus Show layer / Table / CSV. Table and CSV were used only for Density & hotspots.
steps: press Run and watch the timer
read the stats and chart in the Results card
toggle Show layer or open Table
serves_tasks: Map cell density and find hotspots
Measure how far each cell of one type is from the nearest cell of another type
Test whether a cell type is clustered beyond chance across distances
Find which cell types sit next to each other more than chance
Test whether a per-cell measurement is spatially autocorrelated

features.name: Objects-to-regions builder that unlocks region analyses
features.general: Merge nearby objects of a chosen type into contiguous regions, with a joining distance and minimum size. The resulting region layer then becomes available to region-based analyses and to 'only inside' filters.
features.specific: Layer ⋯ > Make regions…: Objects = Tumor, Join closer than 20 µm, Smallest region 1000 µm², giving the 'Regions · synthetic_he.geojson' FOUND layer (22). The Analyze tab's Regions group (Margin bands, Infiltration, Composition) and 'Only inside' then list it. Only Composition was run with it, and 'Only inside' was not tried.
steps: pick a class and the join distance / minimum area
use the new region layer in Composition or Only inside
serves_tasks: Merge nearby cells of one type into regions

features.name: Click-to-segment with accept/discard (SAM)
features.general: Click on an object in the image to get an automatic outline proposal, check it, then accept it into a named annotation class or discard it.
features.specific: SAM tool (8) with bundled SAM 2.1 tiny int8 ONNX on CPU. Click a nucleus and a cyan outline appears ('3 regions, score 0.38, 94.7 ms'; the first click waits about 6 s while the image is encoded). Enter accepts it into Annotations · Area 1; Esc discards.
steps: click an object (more clicks add prompts)
press Enter to accept or Esc to discard
serves_tasks: Outline a cell automatically from one click

features.name: Example-based object finder (mark examples, then find all like these)
features.general: Collect a few example objects by outlining, drawing or picking existing detections, shown as removable chips. Then search a scope (this view or the whole image) for similar objects, with a strictness slider and an exclusion region.
features.specific: Annotate tab: step 1 Mark examples (SAM / Pick objects P / drawing tools, saved to layer + class, 'use as examples'). Step 2 Find all like them (Similar objects / Segment everything / Areas / By text; Search layer, Where, Not inside, Strictness) and press Find all like these. Unverified: the find step was started twice (whole slide, then this view), stayed on 'measuring the objects…' and crashed the tab both times, so its output was never seen.
serves_tasks: Outline a cell automatically from one click

features.name: Per-object inspector popup and hover tooltips
features.general: Hover any drawn object to see its layer and class. Click it for a popup with its id and measurements, each shown with a percentile bar within the layer, plus zoom-to and copy actions.
features.specific: Hovering shows e.g. 'default · Nearest Immune · from Tumor' or '+0…+100 µm · Margin bands · Regions'. Clicking a nucleus opens 'Immune · synthetic_he.geojson #63,582 · area 74.1' with Zoom in / Copy.

features.name: Multi-pane viewer with linked zoom
features.general: Split the viewer into several panes of the same or different images and link their zoom, to compare overlays side by side. Zooming one pane changes the others by the same relative amount; each pane keeps its own centre and framing.
features.specific: Panes 1–32 and Sync none/all/pan/zoom. With 2 panes and Sync = all, zooming pane 1 also zoomed pane 2 by the same relative amount, but pane 2 kept its own centre and extent (066). Pane 2 shows the analysis layers.
serves_tasks: Compare two views side by side with linked zoom
